sources.title: gemma-3-27b-it: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gemma-3-27b-it is a 27-billion parameter instruction-tuned language model from google-deepmind that processes text and images to generate text responses. Built on the same research and technology behind Google's Gemini models, this model features a 128K token context window, multilingual support across over 140 languages, and multimodal capabilities for handling both text and image ...

sources.title: Gemma 3 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 3 is the most capable model that can run on a single GPU or TPU. Efficient on workstations, laptops, and even smartphones, allowing developers to build responsible AI applications at scale.
